http/internal/http2_controls#

HTTP/2 control frames: RST_STREAM, PING and GOAWAY, read and written.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

HTTP/2 control frames: RST_STREAM, PING and GOAWAY, read and written.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.
